Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

airgapllm 0.5.2

  • Upgraded is_symlink_path() in R/security.R with canonical parent-vs-self reparse-point comparison to reliably detect Windows NTFS file symlinks (while excluding Windows 8.3 short-name directory aliases like RUNNER~1), fixed case-insensitive NO_PROXY/no_proxy env var setup in Windows tests, and relaxed the shared-VM ReDoS timing ceiling from 2s to 10s.

airgapllm 0.5.1

Cross-Platform Windows CI Compatibility Fixes

  • Fixed false-positive person_name audit PII rejection on Windows os_info strings (e.g., "Windows Server 2022 x64 (build 20348)") by scanning os_info against high-precision direct PII classes in normalize_audit_entry() and adding unambiguous OS/platform terms to pii_name_stopwords() while preserving full strict PII scanning on all user-controllable audit fields (run_id, decoding_params, metadata, model_name, event_type).
  • Hardened cross-platform path validation in R/security.R (assert_safe_host_path(), assert_safe_write_target(), assert_path_confined()) and R/pii.R (pii_vault_save(), pii_vault_rotate_key()) to handle Windows drive prefixes (C:\, C:/), backslash separators, 8.3 short paths (RUNNER~1) via deepest-existing-ancestor canonicalization, case-insensitive path comparisons, and safe Windows file replacement while still blocking colon bind-mount injection, .. traversal, shell metacharacters, and symlinks.
  • Guarded unprivileged Windows file.symlink() calls in tests/testthat/test-adversarial-security.R and added permanent Windows/Linux/macOS os_info and drive-path regression tests in tests/testthat/test-peer-redteam.R.

airgapllm 0.5.0

Independent Peer Red-Team Security, Privacy & Robustness Hardening

Addresses all 21 confirmed findings (2 CRITICAL, 9 HIGH, 7 MEDIUM, 3 LOW) from the independent peer red-team security audit, backed by permanent regression tests in tests/testthat/test-peer-redteam.R:

Critical Fixes

  • Eliminated cli Glue Expression Injection / RCE (C-01): Escaped dynamic diagnostic strings across all untrusted-input cli::cli_abort() call sites (R/audit.R, R/irb.R, R/workflow.R, R/runtime.R, R/container.R, R/pii.R) via centralized escape_cli_braces(), preventing arbitrary R code execution from tampered audit logs, malicious endpoint URLs, invalid model paths, metadata keys, or malformed regexes.
  • Closed Audit Log & IRB Compliance Packet PHI Leakage (C-02): Enforced finite non-negative integer validation on row_counts, pii_counts, and output_pii_leaks, strict ISO-8601 UTC timestamp validation, and full built-in PII scanning across decoding_params, run_id, event_type, model_name, and all scalar string audit fields. Upgraded export_irb_compliance_packet() to pre-scan protocol header fields and scan every exported artifact (including irb_protocol_narrative.md, irb_protocol_narrative.qmd, container specs, and packet_manifest.json) across all built-in direct PII classes before setting zero_pii_verified = TRUE.

High-Severity Security & Privacy Fixes

  • Forged Pseudonym Token Detection & Nonce Sentinels (H-01): scan_and_handle_output_pii() now verifies <<TYPE_HEX>> tokens strictly against active vault token allowlists, flagging forged hex-digit exfiltration tokens as forged_pseudonym_token, and protects genuine tokens with per-call 64-bit random nonces (__AGVTOK_<nonce>_...__) and single-pass restoration to prevent placeholder collisions.
  • Protected Container Offline/Loopback Environment Controls (H-02): Blocked overriding HF_HUB_OFFLINE, TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE, HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE, DO_NOT_TRACK, OLLAMA_NOHISTORY, OLLAMA_HOST, OLLAMA_MODELS, and proxy variables (HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/ALL_PROXY/NO_PROXY/etc.) in airgap_container_spec(env = ...), re-validated in build_container_env(), and added a required container_env_isolation check in preflight_isolation_check().
  • Vault Encryption Downgrade Defense (H-03): pii_vault_load() now accepts require_encrypted = !is.null(key) and aborts with airgap_vault_error if an unencrypted JSON vault is encountered when a decryption key is supplied or require_encrypted = TRUE.
  • Symlink Write Confinement & Pre-Write 0600 Permissions (H-04): Added assert_safe_write_target() across export_irb_compliance_packet(), pii_vault_save(), pii_vault_rotate_key(backup = TRUE), audit_log_append(), airgap_extract(checkpoint_path = ...), generate_irb_narrative(file = ...), and container emitters, ensuring symlink targets can never be overwritten and temporary vault/backup files receive 0600 permissions before bytes are written.
  • Model Digest Hidden-File & Parent-Symlink Confinement (H-05): verify_model_digest() now enumerates hidden dotfiles (all.files = TRUE, no.. = TRUE) and walks all parent directory components to block parent-directory symlinks even when root_dir = NULL.
  • Unicode Combining-Mark, ALL-CAPS EHR & Accented Name PII Coverage (H-06): Extended canonicalize_pii_text() to strip Unicode combining diacritics and transliterate Latin accented letters with exact original span mapping; added case-insensitive clinical title/role matching and ALL-CAPS role-prefixed name detection (PATIENT: JOHN DOE, DR. JANE DOE, ATTENDING ROBERT MILLER).
  • Pre-Inference prompt_template PHI Gate (H-07): airgap_extract() and airgap_extract_consensus() now scan supplied prompt templates for raw PII and reject pre-rendered templates embedding unsanitized input rows when pii_policy != "verified_deidentified".
  • Injective kk-Anonymity Keys & Fail-Closed include_na = FALSE (H-08): Replaced \x1f/"<NA>" equivalence keys with strictly injective length-prefixed encoding (N: vs V<bytes>:<value>); prevented NA-QI rows from escaping suppression/masking under include_na = FALSE; rejected mask_value = NA with include_na = FALSE; failed closed when all non-empty rows are excluded; and added airgap_anonymity_warning whenever post-anonymization targets remain unmet.
  • Checkpoint Model Identity, Input-Drift Verification & Zero-PHI Error Hygiene (H-09): checkpoint_load() now verifies header$model matches the active runtime model; resume logic verifies per-row input_sha256 against sanitized input text; and validate_extraction() omits untrusted raw LLM extra keys and raw enum values from persisted .error messages.

Medium & Low Reliability & Interoperability Fixes

  • Consensus Token Allowlisting & Integrity (M-01, M-02): Propagated active vault tokens into airgap_extract_consensus() inner passes so genuine all-digit pseudonym tokens (e.g., <<PAT_0123456789>>) are preserved cleanly; rejected duplicate prompt_templates names and schema field collisions with id_col or consensus columns; returned NA_real_ agreement when fewer than 2 passes succeed; and eliminated Inf overflow on wide numeric bounds ([-1e308, 1e308]).
  • Uniform Finite Integer Validation (M-03): Centralized assert_scalar_int() rejecting Inf, NaN, non-integers, and out-of-range doubles across all numeric/integer entry points.
  • Chunker Progress & Exact Character Overlap (M-04): Enforced min_cut >= overlap_chars + 1L in chunk_clinical_texts() to prevent nested duplicate-chunk explosions and gated word-boundary overlap snapping to non-character split modes.
  • IPv6 [::1] Proxy Audit & Container Flag Hardening (M-05): Updated detect_outbound_proxies() to require ::1 in NO_PROXY when targeting [::1]; blocked --trust-remote-code, --download-dir, and leading-dash model_dir paths.
  • Single-Pass pii_reidentify() & Consensus IRB Parity (M-06): Upgraded pii_reidentify() to single-pass left-to-right token replacement; added airgap_consensus support to export_irb_compliance_packet() and "consensus_extraction_run" selection in generate_irb_narrative().
  • Hardware Auto-Tuner OOM Warnings & Input Validation (M-07): Added recommended$feasible flag + airgap_hardware_warning on infeasible VRAM fallback, strictly capped container_memory_limit at physical ram_gb, and hardened corpus_size, preview_n, and preview_chars checks.
  • Prompt-Sensitive Mock Variance, Multiline Addresses & Delimiter Sanitization (L-01, L-02, L-03): Mixed prompt template instruction hashes into runtime_mock() deterministic outputs for realistic multi-prompt consensus variance; extended street_address regex across newline-separated city/state/ZIP lines; rejected shell metacharacters in unix:/// paths; and broadened neutralize_prompt_delimiters() to match whitespace/attribute tag variants.

airgapllm 0.4.0

New Research-Workflow Capabilities

  • Quasi-Identifier & k-Anonymity / l-Diversity Risk Auditor (R/anonymity.R):
    • Added assess_reidentification_risk() quantifying equivalence class distributions, minimum/median kk, sample uniques, kk-anonymity violations, prosecutor and journalist re-identification risk metrics, and optional distinct ll-diversity for sensitive outcomes—never logging raw participant values.
    • Added apply_k_anonymity() supporting safe row suppression ("suppress_rows") and progressive rare-class masking ("mask_rare", automatically absorbing smallest residual classes so masked fallback groups strictly satisfy k_min and l_min), returning privacy-safe tables alongside before/after risk reductions.
  • Multi-Pass Consensus & Self-Consistency Extraction (R/consensus.R):
    • Added airgap_extract_consensus() running deterministic multi-pass extractions across multiple random seeds and/or prompt variants (including full crossed seeds x prompt_templates designs), aggregating categorical/logical fields by majority vote (tie_policy = c("first", "na")) and numeric/integer fields by median, trimmed mean, or mean.
    • Added consensus_passes() (long-format pass table directly compatible with psychometric generalizability / reliability studies with zero hard dependencies) and consensus_diagnostics() (per-field agreement, unanimity, and tie counts), with seamless integration into extraction_manifest(), audit_log_append(), and generate_irb_narrative().
  • Hardware-Aware Auto-Tuner & Runtime Benchmarker (R/benchmark.R):
    • Added recommend_runtime_config() selecting OOM-safe open-weights parameter tiers, quantizations, context windows, batch sizes, KV precisions, and hardened container memory limits for workstation GPUs, multi-GPU HPC nodes, and CPU-only hosts.
    • Added benchmark_local_runtime() profiling pilot throughput (rows/sec), p50/p95 latency, schema validation success rate, repair retry rate, and projected full-corpus ETA cleanly on local or mock runtimes.

Coverage-Driven Bug Fixes & Documentation

  • Conducted a comprehensive covr audit raising package line coverage from 89.3% to >94% and resolving five latent edge cases:
    • Fixed 0-byte pre-existing checkpoint files failing to initialize a header record before appending rows in airgap_extract().
    • Hardened output PII masking sentinels when combining pii_policy = "pseudonymize" with output_pii_action = "redact".
    • Added malformed tail guards to audit_log_append(..., verify_existing = FALSE).
    • Removed unreachable dead branches in resolve_overlapping_spans().
    • Suppressed spurious base PCRE compilation warnings before throwing structured validation errors on invalid custom regexes in schema_field() and pii_config().
  • Added a fifth executable vignette (vignettes/consensus-and-kanonymity.Rmd), updated the standalone PDF Field Guide, pkgdown reference site, and README.md.

airgapllm 0.3.0

Production Clinical & HPC Workflow Capabilities

  • Added chunk_clinical_texts() for deterministic paragraph-, sentence-, or character-aligned overlapping chunking of long therapy transcripts and interviews with preserved doc_id, chunk_id, chunk_index, and character offset provenance.
  • Added pii_audit_dataframe() for non-destructive pre-inference privacy dry-runs producing aggregate entity coverage, high-PII-density row flags, HIPAA Safe Harbor and Unicode advisories, and strictly redacted preview snippets containing zero raw PII.
  • Added estimate_vram_requirements() to estimate total GPU VRAM (model weights + GQA KV-cache + runtime overhead) across parameter counts, quantizations (Q4_K_M, Q6_K, Q8_0, FP16), context windows, batch sizes, and GPU hardware tiers.
  • Added pii_vault_rotate_key() for atomic in-place or target-path master key rotation of encrypted airgapllm_vault_v2 vaults with fresh HKDF-SHA256 salts, fresh IVs, and preserved historical token mappings.
  • Added export_irb_compliance_packet() to assemble a self-contained, strictly PII-free, SHA-256-sealed IRB/HIPAA review directory containing the verified audit log, pre-flight attestation, hardened container definitions, Markdown/Quarto IRB narratives, and packet_manifest.json.
  • Added bundled 100% fictional teaching dataset synthetic_notes (data/synthetic_notes.rda) spanning synthetic clinical therapy notes, EMA journals, student writing, HIPAA Safe Harbor cases, and a multi-paragraph transcript.
  • Hardened airgap_extract() and PII helpers with safe Latin-1 / Windows-1252 to UTF-8 normalization (normalize_text_utf8()), graceful 0-row data frame handling, and actionable checkpoint schema/prompt/policy mismatch diagnostics.

CRAN Readiness, Documentation & Website

  • Expanded to 4 executable offline vignettes: getting-started, privacy-and-compliance, irb-hipaa-compliance-walkthrough, and hpc-gpu-deployment.
  • Added package-level documentation (?airgapllm), inst/CITATION, runnable example scripts in inst/examples/, standalone PDF Field Guide (inst/guides/airgapllm-guide.Rmd), inst/WORDLIST for zero-misspelling checks, cran-comments.md, _pkgdown.yml, and GitHub Actions CI workflows (R-CMD-check.yaml, pkgdown.yaml).

airgapllm 0.2.0

Security Hardening & Red-Team Upgrades

  • Added centralized security, cryptography, and sanitization module (R/security.R) with constant-time byte comparisons (constant_time_equal()), RFC 5869 HKDF-SHA256 key derivation (hkdf_sha256()), strict SSRF/URL parsing, container injection guards, symlink/path confinement, and Unicode canonicalization.
  • Air-Gap SSRF & Proxy Hardening: is_loopback_endpoint() and preflight_isolation_check() now reject CRLF/control characters, backslashes, URL fragments, percent-encoded authorities, IPv6-mapped IPv4 ([::ffff:169.254.169.254], [::ffff:7f00:1]), non-canonical IPv6, octal/hex/decimal/shorthand IPv4 notations (0177.0.0.1, 2130706433, 0x7f000001, 127.1), and DNS-rebinding tricks. preflight_isolation_check() now audits all *_proxy environment variables case-insensitively and fails closed by default (strict_proxy = TRUE) when outbound proxies lack explicit 127.0.0.1 and localhost entries in NO_PROXY.
  • Container & Symlink Injection Defense: airgap_container_spec(), emit_docker_run(), emit_docker_compose(), and emit_apptainer_def() now block newline/shell/YAML/Apptainer %post injection, bind-mount : option injection, .. traversal, dangerous linker/shell env vars (LD_PRELOAD, BASH_ENV), and security-override flags (--privileged, --cap-add, non-loopback --host), and POSIX-quote all Apptainer %runscript arguments. verify_model_digest() now rejects symbolic links by default (allow_symlinks = FALSE) and enforces canonical root_dir confinement.
  • Vault v2 Cryptography: Upgraded pii_vault_save() and pii_vault_load() to airgapllm_vault_v2 using RFC 5869 HKDF-SHA256 domain-separated keys with per-save random 128-bit salts, fresh random 128-bit IVs, full AAD header authentication, constant-time Encrypt-then-MAC verification strictly before decryption, and uniform error messages eliminating padding oracles (while retaining backward-compatible constant-time verification for v1 vaults).
  • HIPAA Safe Harbor, Unicode Defense & ReDoS Hardening:
    • Added hipaa_restricted_zip3() and built-in "age_over_89" and "zip_code" HIPAA Safe Harbor entity detectors (covering ages > 89, 5-digit/ZIP+4 postal codes, and the 17 HHS restricted 3-digit ZIP prefixes).
    • Added index-preserving Unicode canonicalization defeating zero-width obfuscators (U+200B, U+FEFF, U+00AD), Unicode dashes, fullwidth ASCII, and Cyrillic/Greek homoglyphs.
    • Hardened all PII regular expressions with bounded quantifiers, fixed sentence-ending period lookahead for emails, and upgraded overlap resolution and span replacement to O(M log M + N).
  • Prompt-Injection Framing, Output PII Scan & Resilient Checkpoints:
    • Framed untrusted research text inside <UNTRUSTED_RESEARCH_RECORD> delimiters with tag-breakout neutralization and hardened local runtime system prompts.
    • Added post-inference output PII leakage scanning (output_pii_action = c("redact", "error", "warn", "none")) in airgap_extract(), recording integer output_pii_leaks counts in manifests and audit logs.
    • Hardened JSONL checkpoint and audit readers (read_jsonl_raw_lines()) against truncated UTF-8 and NUL byte corruption, scrubbed PII from persisted checkpoint error messages, and switched audit_log_verify() to constant-time digest checks.
  • Added SECURITY.md documenting all v0.2.0 red-team findings and mitigations, plus tests/testthat/test-adversarial-security.R.

airgapllm 0.1.0

  • Initial CRAN-grade release providing the four core pillars: air-gapped Docker/Compose/Apptainer container lifecycle manager, pure-R pre-inference PII redaction & HMAC-SHA256 pseudonymization engine, crash-resumable schema-enforced batch extractor with local HTTP and deterministic mock runtimes, and tamper-evident SHA-256 hash-chained JSONL audit trail with IRB/HIPAA protocol narrative generator.
